mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NOTICE_CODE AS noticeCode, TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, NOTICE_TYPE AS noticeType, TO_CHAR(INPUT_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS noticeDate, LAG(NOTICE_CODE, 1) OVER (ORDER BY NOTICE_CODE DESC) AS prevNoticeCode, LEAD(NOTICE_CODE, 1) OVER (ORDER BY NOTICE_CODE DESC) AS nextNoticeCode FROM NOTICE WHERE STATUS = '공개' ) WHERE noticeCode = TO_NUMBER(#{noticeCode})
